query: (no query — a probe for the Parent.Template* scope rule)

provenance.source: Built from a verbatim Studio error in field report 01: "Name isn't valid. 'TemplateWidth' isn't recognized. Location: Check_Body.Width"

expected_behavior: Card_Direct, the gallery's direct child, produces NO error despite using Parent.TemplateWidth and Parent.TemplateHeight
The error message quotes the Studio wording so a reader can match it to what they saw
notes: The 1 HOUSE warning is the LayoutOverflowY count — expected, this is a probe and not a real screen.
Both sides of the rule live in one file deliberately: a check that only errors is half-tested, and a scope rule that over-fires would break every real gallery.
